title: Improving Proficiency and Efficiency of Android GUI Agents via Self-Generating Tool Actions
abstract: arXiv:2609.06792v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Android agents using a hybrid action space that combines GUI actions and tool actions (e.g., accessing application data via APIs) remain largely underexplored, mainly due to the excessive effort required to create tools. To address this gap, we introduce DroidTool, a framework for augmenting the agents with self-generated tools, which are realized as Python functions operating on application states (e.g., a database). To create tools with minimal human labor, DroidTool employs an agentic workflow featuring stages: proposal, implementation, test generation and execution, and repair. Notably, when testing the created tools for verification, it constructs relational tests across relevant tools for natural preparation of appropriate test preconditions and improved test coverage, rather than testing each tool separately. The GUI agents augmented with the generated tools achieved approximately 4.47%p higher performance with approximately 20.05

translated_title: 通过自生成工具操作提升Android GUI智能体的熟练度与效率
translated_abstract: 采用混合动作空间（结合GUI操作和工具操作，例如通过API访问应用数据）的Android智能体在很大程度上仍未被充分探索，主要原因是创建工具需要付出过多的努力。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了DroidTool，这是一个通过自生成工具来增强智能体的框架，这些工具被实现为在应用状态（例如数据库）上操作的Python函数。为了以最少的人工劳动创建工具，DroidTool采用了一个智能体工作流，包含以下阶段：提案、实现、测试生成与执行、以及修复。值得注意的是，在测试所创建的工具进行验证时，它会构建跨相关工具的关系测试，以自然地准备适当的测试前置条件并提高测试覆盖率，而不是单独测试每个工具。使用所生成工具增强的GUI智能体实现了约4.47个百分点的更高性能，同时效率提升约20.05
tldr: 提出DroidTool框架，通过自动生成以Python函数形式操作应用状态的工具来增强Android GUI智能体，并采用跨相关工具的关系测试进行验证，使智能体性能提升约4.47个百分点、效率提升约20.05%。
en_tdlr: DroidTool is a framework that automatically generates Python function-based tools operating on application states to augment Android GUI agents, employing relational cross-tool testing for verification, yielding approximately 4.47%p higher performance and about 20.05% improved efficiency.
